chunks.en: Good morning, I'm the new office assistant.
chunks.zh: 早安，我是新來的辦公室助理。
accept: Good morning, I am the new office assistant.
chunks.note: 第一天到公司報到，先打招呼再說自己是誰。

distractors.text: Good morning, I'm new office assistant.
Good morning, I'm the office new assistant.
Good morning, I'm the new office assistent.

chunks.en: Does this badge open the front door?
chunks.zh: 這張識別證可以開大門嗎？
chunks.note: 問東西能不能用。主詞是 this badge，用 Does，後面動詞用原形。

distractors.text: Does this badge opens the front door?
Do this badge open the front door?
Does this badge open front door?

chunks.en: Who should I put as my supervisor?
chunks.note: 填表格時問某一欄要寫誰。put 某人 as… = 把某人填成……。

distractors.text: Who should I put my supervisor?
Who I should put as my supervisor?
Who should I put as my supervisior?

chunks.en: When do you need these forms back?
chunks.zh: 這些表格什麼時候要交回來？
accept: When do you need the forms back?
chunks.note: 問交件期限。back 放在句尾，表示「交回來」。

distractors.text: When you need these forms back?
When do you need these form back?
When do you need back these forms?

chunks.en: Is lunch provided, or should I bring my own?
chunks.zh: 公司有供應午餐嗎？還是要自己帶？
chunks.note: 被動式：is＋過去分詞（provided）= 被提供，不必說是誰提供的。

distractors.text: Is lunch provide, or should I bring my own?
Does lunch provided, or should I bring my own?
Is lunch provided, or should I bring my?

chunks.en: Are we allowed to eat at our desks?
chunks.zh: 我們可以在座位上吃東西嗎？
chunks.note: 被動式問句：Are we allowed to＋原形動詞？= 我們可以……嗎？

distractors.text: Are we allow to eat at our desks?
Are we allowed eat at our desks?
Do we allowed to eat at our desks?

chunks.en: So I should call Ms. Carter before nine, right?
chunks.zh: 所以我要在九點前打給 Ms. Carter，對嗎？
accept: So I should call Ms. Carter before 9, right?
chunks.note: 讀完規定跟對方確認你懂得對不對。句尾加 right? = 對吧？

distractors.text: So I should calling Ms. Carter before nine, right?
So I should call to Ms. Carter before nine, right?
So I should call Ms. Carter before nine, rigth?

chunks.en: How many vacation days do I get?
chunks.note: 問有幾天假。數得出來的東西用 How many＋複數名詞。

distractors.text: How much vacation days do I get?
How many vacation day do I get?
How many vacation days I get?

chunks.en: Are we paid every two weeks?
chunks.zh: 我們是每兩個禮拜發一次薪水嗎？
chunks.note: 問多久發一次薪水。be paid = 領到薪水，是被動式。

distractors.text: Are we pay every two weeks?
Are we paid every two week?
Are we paid every the two weeks?

chunks.en: I just need a few more minutes.
chunks.note: 數量詞：a few＋可數的複數名詞 = 幾個；a few more = 再幾個。

distractors.text: I just need a little more minutes.
I just need a few more minute.
I just need a few more minits.

chunks.en: Sure, I have plenty of time this afternoon.
chunks.zh: 沒問題，我今天下午時間很充裕。
chunks.note: 數量詞：plenty of＋名詞 = 很多、足夠，可數不可數都能用。

distractors.text: Sure, I have plenty time this afternoon.
Sure, I have plenty of times this afternoon.
Sure, I have plenty of time in this afternoon.

chunks.en: I'm excited to be part of the team.
chunks.zh: 很高興能加入這個團隊。
accept: I am excited to be part of the team.
I'm excited to be a part of the team.
chunks.note: 加入新團隊時說。excited to＋原形動詞 = 很期待做某事。

distractors.text: I'm exciting to be part of the team.
I'm excited to part of the team.
I'm excited to be part of team.

chunks.en: I'll finish the rest first thing tomorrow.
chunks.zh: 剩下的我明天一早就做完。
accept: I will finish the rest first thing tomorrow.
chunks.note: 事情今天做不完時說。the rest = 剩下的；first thing = 一早。

distractors.text: I'll finishing the rest first thing tomorrow.
I'll finish rest first thing tomorrow.
I'll finish the rest first thing tomorow.

chunks.en: I think I'm going to like it here.
accept: I think I am going to like it here.
chunks.note: 說你對新環境的感覺。be going to＋原形 = 覺得之後會……。

distractors.text: I think I going to like it here.
I think I'm going to liking it here.
I think I'm going to like it hear.

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Good morning, I'm the new office assistant.
scene.zh: 早安，我是新來的辦公室助理。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome! I'm Ms. Reed from Human Resources. HR for short.
scene.zh: 歡迎！我是人力資源部的 Reed，簡稱人資。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll do your orientation this morning.
scene.zh: 今天早上由我幫你做到職說明。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: First, a picture for your badge. Look at the camera, please.
scene.zh: 先拍識別證的照片。請看鏡頭。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Here's your badge. All staff wear one.
scene.zh: 很好。這是你的識別證，所有員工都要戴。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does this badge open the front door?
scene.zh: 這張識別證可以開大門嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. It gives you access to the whole office.
scene.zh: 可以。整間辦公室你都能進出。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, let's sit down. I have some forms for you.
scene.zh: 好，我們坐下來吧。我有幾張表格要給你填。

fills.en: I need two forms of ___, like your passport.
fills.zh: 我需要兩種身分證明，像是你的護照。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now, a few forms. This one is for payroll.
scene.zh: 接下來填幾張表格。這張是薪資用的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Write your official name, the one on your passport.
scene.zh: 寫你的正式名字，就是護照上那個。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Who should I put as my supervisor?
scene.zh: 主管這一欄我要填誰？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ms. Carter. You'll meet her again this afternoon.
scene.zh: Carter。你今天下午會再見到她。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This last one asks for an emergency contact.
scene.zh: 最後這張要填緊急聯絡人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Most people put a family member. I put my daughter.
scene.zh: 大部分的人都填家人。我是填我女兒。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: When do you need these forms back?
scene.zh: 這些表格什麼時候要交回來？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: By Friday is fine. Take your time.
scene.zh: 星期五前交就可以了，慢慢來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me show you around. Kate is our receptionist.
scene.zh: 我帶你到處看看。Kate 是我們的櫃台。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And this is the kitchen. Coffee and tea are provided.
scene.zh: 這裡是茶水間。咖啡和茶公司都有提供。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is lunch provided, or should I bring my own?
scene.zh: 公司有供應午餐嗎？還是要自己帶？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, lunch isn't. Most of us bring something from home.
scene.zh: 午餐就沒有了，不好意思。我們大多是從家裡帶。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Are we allowed to eat at our desks?
scene.zh: 我們可以在座位上吃東西嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, you are. Cups are kept in this cabinet.
scene.zh: 可以啊。杯子都放在這個櫃子裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The meeting room is located next to the kitchen.
scene.zh: 會議室就在茶水間隔壁。

passages.title: Your First Week
lines: Welcome to Harbor Trading! We are a small organization, and we want a friendly, professional workplace.
Badge: Wear your badge every day. It identifies you as staff.
Sick days: Call your supervisor before 9:00 on any day you are absent.
Your information: All your forms are kept in the HR office. They are confidential.
Facilities: The kitchen and the meeting room are open to all staff.
Questions about a policy? Ask Ms. Reed.

questions.en: You are sick. What should you do?
Who should you ask about a policy?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This is the staff handbook. Please read the first page.
scene.zh: 這是員工手冊，請先看第一頁。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Look at the part about sick days. That policy is important.
scene.zh: 看一下請病假那一段，那條規定很重要。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So I should call Ms. Carter before nine, right?
scene.zh: 所以我要在九點前打給 Ms. Carter，對嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. She's your supervisor, so call her, not me.
scene.zh: 對。她是你的主管，所以打給她，不是打給我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And don't worry, your forms stay with me. They're confidential.
scene.zh: 還有別擔心，你的表格都放我這裡，會保密的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Any questions about a policy? Just ask me.
scene.zh: 對規定有任何問題，直接問我就好。

lines.en: Yes. All full time workers are eligible for health insurance.
lines.zh: 有。所有全職員工都符合健康保險的資格。

lines.en: Great. What do I need to do?
You need to enroll online by this Friday.
lines.zh: 你要在這個星期五以前上網加保。

lines.en: Okay. And I get ten vacation days this year, right?
lines.zh: 好。還有我今年有十天特休，對嗎？

lines.en: Right, ten in your first year.

questions.en: How many vacation days does the new worker get?
What does the new worker need to do by Friday?
questions.zh: 新員工星期五以前要做什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's it for the tour. Any other questions for me?
scene.zh: 參觀就到這裡。還有什麼問題要問我嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How many vacation days do I get?
scene.zh: 我有幾天特休？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ten days in your first year. You earn them from your first month.
scene.zh: 第一年十天，從第一個月就開始累積。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Are we paid every two weeks?
scene.zh: 我們是每兩個禮拜發一次薪水嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Payday is every other Friday.
scene.zh: 對，每隔一個星期五發薪。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your first paycheck comes next week.
scene.zh: 你的第一份薪水下個禮拜就會入帳。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Any more questions, come and see me. My door is always open.
scene.zh: 還有問題就來找我，我隨時都在。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi there! Are you done with Ms. Reed's forms?
scene.zh: 嗨！Reed 的表格填完了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I just need a few more minutes.
scene.zh: 我再幾分鐘就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's okay. First, let me explain your role.
scene.zh: 沒關係。我先跟你說明一下你的職務。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your main responsibility is to help the team: filing, mail, orders.
scene.zh: 你主要的職責是協助團隊：歸檔、信件、訂單。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I have several small jobs for you today.
scene.zh: 我今天有幾件小事要交給你。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sure, I have plenty of time this afternoon.
scene.zh: 沒問題，我今天下午時間很充裕。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Here's your first assignment. Are you familiar with Excel?
scene.zh: 太好了。這是你的第一份工作。你熟悉 Excel 嗎？

lines.en: Here's a short overview of the company.
lines.zh: 我簡單介紹一下公司的概況。

lines.en: We sell desk lamps and other products for the home and office.
lines.zh: 我們賣桌燈，還有其他居家和辦公室用的產品。

lines.en: Yes, only to stores. Mr. Ellis is our director.
lines.zh: 對，只賣給店家。Ellis 先生是我們的總經理。

lines.en: He started the company almost twenty years ago.
lines.zh: 他快二十年前創立了這家公司。

lines.en: Who should I ask when I have a question?
lines.zh: 我有問題的時候要問誰？

lines.en: Dan is our senior sales person. He sits next to you. Ask him first.
lines.zh: Dan 是我們資深的業務，他坐你隔壁。先問他。

lines.en: Our shipping department is in the warehouse.
lines.zh: 我們的出貨部門在倉庫那邊。

questions.en: Who should the new worker ask first?
questions.zh: 新員工有問題要先問誰？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Time for a few introductions. You met Ms. Reed already.
scene.zh: 來介紹一下大家。Reed 你已經見過了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We're a small team, only six people.
scene.zh: 我們是個小團隊，只有六個人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: In our culture, we ask questions and help each other.
scene.zh: 我們的文化就是：有問題就問，互相幫忙。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your ability to speak Chinese is important here, too.
scene.zh: 你會說中文的能力在這裡也很重要。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Our new products are made in Taiwan.
scene.zh: 我們的新產品是在台灣做的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm excited to be part of the team.
scene.zh: 很高興能加入這個團隊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We're happy to have you. Your knowledge of Chinese will help.
scene.zh: 我們很高興有你加入。你懂中文會很有幫助。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, how was your first day?
scene.zh: 那麼，第一天過得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think I'm going to like it here.
scene.zh: 我覺得我會喜歡這裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You're still smiling. That's a good sign.
scene.zh: 你還在笑，這是好兆頭。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you submit all your paperwork?
scene.zh: 你的文件都交了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll finish the rest first thing tomorrow.
scene.zh: 剩下的我明天一早就做完。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's fine. Your permanent badge will be ready on Friday.
scene.zh: 沒關係。你的正式識別證星期五會做好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Tomorrow I'll show you our procedure for orders.
scene.zh: 明天我再教你處理新訂單的流程。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning! Can I help you?
scene.zh: 早安！有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Good morning, I'm the new office assistant.
scene.zh: 早安，我是新來的辦公室助理。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome! I'm Ms. Reed. Here's your temporary badge.
scene.zh: 歡迎！我是 Reed。這是你的臨時識別證。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does this badge open the front door?
scene.zh: 這張識別證可以開大門嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It does, and the staff entrance, too. Now, please fill out these forms.
scene.zh: 可以，員工入口也能開。好，接下來請你填這些表格。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Who should I put as my supervisor?
scene.zh: 主管這一欄我要填誰？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ms. Carter. And here's the handbook. Read the part about sick days.
scene.zh: Carter。還有這是員工手冊，看一下請病假那一段。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So I should call Ms. Carter before nine, right?
scene.zh: 所以我要在九點前打給 Ms. Carter，對嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Exactly. Any other questions?
scene.zh: 沒錯。還有其他問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How many vacation days do I get?
scene.zh: 我有幾天特休？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ten in your first year. And coffee is provided in the kitchen.
scene.zh: 第一年十天。對了，茶水間有提供咖啡。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is lunch provided, or should I bring my own?
scene.zh: 公司有供應午餐嗎？還是要自己帶？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Bring your own, sorry. Look, here's Ms. Carter now.
scene.zh: 要自己帶，不好意思。你看，Carter 來了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome! Are you almost done here?
scene.zh: 歡迎！你這邊快好了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I just need a few more minutes.
scene.zh: 我再幾分鐘就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Take your time. Everyone is excited to meet you.
scene.zh: 慢慢來。大家都很期待見到你。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm excited to be part of the team.
scene.zh: 很高興能加入這個團隊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. So, what do you think of us so far?
scene.zh: 很好。那麼，到目前為止你覺得我們怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think I'm going to like it here.
scene.zh: 我覺得我會喜歡這裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. We're flexible about lunch, so come find me after.
scene.zh: 太好了。午餐時間很有彈性，吃完再來找我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then I'll explain your role and your routine.
scene.zh: 到時候我再跟你說明你的職務和例行工作。
